rows.behavior: No rule outside the aim-managed set mentions loop_harness, loop-harness, v1 or v2.
rows.fails_when: any non-aim file under .claude/rules/ contains loop_harness, loop-harness, or v1 or v2 as a word

rows.behavior: Every ADR a non-aim rule cites exists under .okf/decisions/.
rows.fails_when: a non-aim rule cites ADR NNNN and no .okf/decisions/NNNN-*.md file exists

rows.behavior: Every repository path a non-aim rule cites in backticks exists, or is a planned location or sits under one.
rows.fails_when: a backticked path in a non-aim rule (text or paths: glob) neither exists nor starts with one of the planned locations the plan lists

rows.behavior: AGENTS.md no longer points at the adapt-copied-rules ticket.
The aim-managed rules listed in aim.toml are unchanged.
rows.fails_when: any rule file aim.toml lists differs from its content before this ticket

rows.behavior: Each kept rule is true for kmctl: rules about loopctl's internals are deleted, and a kept rule names loopctl only as the tool this repository's tickets run on.
rows.fails_when: a kept rule states something false about kmctl, or describes loopctl's internals or the loop workflow
